ancient_context_cautions.second_temple_dualism_wisdom: Second Temple and Jewish wisdom light-dark, truth-error, two-way, child, birth, sin and command language may illuminate discourse forms only; it cannot identify a group, establish dependence, select a reading, or decide doctrine, theology, or seams.
ancient_context_cautions.forensic_witness: Torah and Greco-Roman forensic witness conventions may illuminate sensory testimony, two-or-three witnesses and lesser-to-greater testimony only; they cannot authorize a preferred textual witness, historic reconstruction, Christology, canon, or seams.
ancient_context_cautions.johannine: Gospel and Revelation parallels are internal-Bible evidence for repeated vocabulary, discourse architecture and possible allusion only; they cannot decide common authorship, source, dependence, community, chronology, identity, reading, doctrine, theology, or seams.
ancient_context_cautions.later_jewish_rabbinic: Later Jewish and rabbinic discussions of testimony, two ways, repentance, sin, prayer, idolatry and command remain later reception; they cannot be projected backward as source identity, lexical control, halakhic policy, theology, or boundary authority.
ancient_context_cautions.patristic: Patristic reception may expose pressure around opponents, incarnation wording, hilasmos, sinlessness, anointing, testimony variants, assurance and idols; it cannot select a reading, identify opponents, settle Christology, atonement, canon, doctrine, theology, or seams.
ancient_context_cautions.textual_reception: The 4:2-3 confession variants, 5:6-8 witness traditions including the Comma Johanneum, 5:18 keeping wording, and 5:20 referent remain variant/reception evidence only and are held for human or external-AI review.

hardest_seams.why: chapter division competes with a continuous conditional claim/remedy sequence; preserve both 1:5-10 | 2:1-2 and the larger whole
poetic addressee stanzas and world warning differ in form but may function together as assurance followed by prohibition
and-now abiding, appearance, child identity, purification and difficult present-tense sin/seed claims form a recursive transition that risks doctrinal atomization
Cain/love example, material application, heart assurance, prayer and command summary have real internal turns but mutually supply grounds and tests
love/birth/command language crosses the chapter seam; preserve the 4:7-21 whole while retaining a 4:19-5:5 cross-chapter alternative
textual reception at 5:7-8 and movement from witnesses to testimony/life invite proof-text splits; keep the forensic sequence intact
purpose, prayer, sin case, assurance triad and idol warning have distinct forms but collectively close the work; retain both finer and whole-close routes

premortem: Do not use chapter fallback, editorial headings, paragraphing, punctuation, speaker/source labels, textual witness popularity, Johannine parallels, or reception traditions as boundary authority.
Do not atomize every conditional, vocative, by-this formula, we-know statement, confession, witness, catalogue item, or repeated slogan.
Do not detach claim from test or remedy, example from application, confession from witness, prayer from its confidence ground, disputed verse from governing unit, or warning from the close.
Do not infer authorship, source, dependence, community, opponent identity, chronology, history, speaker, audience identity, or reading from literary recursion or canonical echoes.
Do not select Christology, atonement, sinlessness, perfection, election, assurance, prayer/discipline, sin-unto-death, sacramental practice, canon, doctrine, or theology.
Keep exact alternatives and larger macro-parents live; every unit remains LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus.
